description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bandiruppuwa, Wennappuwa D/S Division,Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410005 (23/0360)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
